comparator.name: Bachelor Civil Engineering
comparator.academicYear: Adopted 2026–2027 ordinary cohort requirements; checked against the completed 7 October audit and current source retrieval on 8 October 2026
comparator.sourceNotes: The controlling 2026–2027 Civil Engineering Annex and September 2026 curriculum chart were verified in the completed 7 October audit. Their ordinary 2026-entry structure is 60+60+60=180. Current year-one Water en Techniek CTB1215-26 replaces the older Schone Watersystemen title/code. Formal Transport en planning CTB1420-25 governs the stale CTB1420-17 chart label. Bouwplaats 1 and 2 are each an aggregate 8 EC; their quarter subdivisions are not separately credited at 8 each. Year three is minor 30 + Surveying and Mapping CTB3310 4 + Urban Water and Environmental Engineering CTB3315 4 + Traffic and Transport Infrastructure CTB3325 4 + one Q3 deep-dive 4 + one Q4 design choice 4 + bachelor project CTB3000-16 10 = 60. Restricted options are instantiated by the first-listed eligible choice in each category: Climate Impacts and Engineering CTB3311 and Design of Water Treatment CTB3465, independently of UCR fit. The old unrestricted three-specialisation arrangement applies only to pre-2024 cohorts. The minor remains genuine choice and must not overlap selected degree/elective units. Fresh current programme-page retrieval corroborates the construction/water/transport identity; fresh formal Annex and chart downloads returned HTTP 502, so formal units, weights and visual verification are explicitly carried from the current-year 7 October audit, not claimed as new retrievals.
components: Genuine choice allowance, subject to applicable approval and overlap rules.

exception.reason: The corrected current external pathway is now reconstructed at 180 EC. Its comparison with UCR awaits separate assessment.
